# World Vision International

> World Vision International is a Christian humanitarian organization dedicated to helping vulnerable children overcome poverty through transformational development, emergency relief, and advocacy programs across the globe.

World Vision International operates in over 100 countries with a mission rooted in Christian values. The organization combines emergency response, long-term community development, and advocacy to address child poverty, protection, and welfare. Leadership is headed by CEO Andrew Morley, and the organization works through partnerships with major global institutions like UNICEF, the World Bank, and WHO.

## Key Topics

- Transformational development
- Child protection
- Vulnerable children
- Poverty alleviation
- Emergency response

- Humanitarian work

- [Our History | Development](https://www.wvi.org/our-history): Organizational history page covering founder Bob Pierce and 75 years of World Vision's evolution.
- [Our vision and values](https://www.wvi.org/about-us/our-vision-and-values): Vision and values page articulating World Vision's mission and core organizational principles.
- [Our Leadership](https://www.wvi.org/about-us/our-leadership): Leadership page featuring CEO Andrew Morley and organizational structure information.
- [Our Structure](https://www.wvi.org/about-us/our-structure): Organizational structure page detailing World Vision Partnership governance and global operations.
- [The role of Faith](https://www.wvi.org/role-faith): Faith-based mission page explaining Christian values guiding World Vision's development work.
